settings.show_text.label: Show label
settings.show_text.description: Show the word "kitty" next to the glyph.
settings.socket.label: Kitty socket
settings.socket.description: Explicit remote-control socket, e.g. unix:/run/user/1000/kitty-1234. Leave empty to use KITTY_LISTEN_ON, then auto-discover every $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/kitty* socket. Kitty appends -<pid> to listen_on values, so the socket is not simply 'kitty'.
settings.focus_delay.label: Focus delay (ms)
settings.focus_delay.description: Delay before the first niri workspace switch (ms). Lower is snappier; the plugin re-asserts focus twice after that in case the launcher grabs it back.
